summary: Radiopharm Theranostics Ltd furnished a Form 6-K on October 1, 2026, attaching two ASX announcements: an Appendix 3Y Change of Director's Interest Notice for director Riccardo Canevari and a Notification of Cessation of Securities. The filing discloses lapse of 24,000,000 unlisted options expiring September 30, 2026 at an exercise price of A$0.06; Canevari's direct option holdings fell to 163,301,188, while his 26,568,875 shares were unchanged. No consideration was paid and no shares were issued or cancelled. This is a routine insider-interest update, not a special situation.
